name: Google Sheets aggregator
description: Pull Google Sheets rows into Hangar app data and show a chart-ready dashboard.
instructions: For the Google Sheets aggregator template, keep the backend intentionally small: main.py for routes, sheets.py for Google Sheets reads, sync.py for row conversion, metrics.py for chart summaries, scheduler.py for its Hangar-managed cron job, and store.py for Hangar table access. Users should extend sync.py for new sheet shapes and metrics.py for new charts. Prefer owner-token Google Sheets app auth for scheduled or shared dashboards.
